items.title: Central DHW boilers
items.text: Domestic hot water is generated by central boiler equipment located in the mechanical room. No major equipment deficiencies were reported at the time of the site visit.

items.title: DHW recirculation loop
items.text: The DHW system includes a recirculation loop to maintain service temperature and reduce tap wait times. Pump operation appeared stable based on available observations.

items.title: DHW controls
items.text: DHW temperature control and plant operation are managed using local control logic with BAS visibility. Further tuning may be possible to balance comfort and efficiency.
